steps.detail: Run the existing v6.1 recovery path on the canonical F-host; do not create a second task or runner.
Require receipts 015/016/014/003, exactly one persistent daemon, fresh heartbeat and exact task/attempt/continuation claim.
Verify current canonical files retain PR261 HMLR hashes, DTM1/DTM2 CoverageIds and six WCS response SHA256 values; redownload only if a hash is absent or mismatched.
Use exact Enfield 46058185, Havering 39866294 and Lambeth 62045430 native EPSG27700 polygons; no nearest fallback.
Use preserved EA DTM1m measurements only after hash replay; keep DTM2 as resolution crosscheck and do not call these new Increment165 measurements.

If still required by the independent QA gate, obtain exact National LIDAR Programme intersections from the official metadata service/archive; do not infer a survey for row30762 where Composite has multiple candidates.
Resolve product Terrain50 through the official OS Downloads API, area TQ, require actual current ZIP/ASCII bytes and safe member validation for TQ39/TQ59/TQ27.
Sample actual Terrain50 data using documented grid semantics and compare against the preserved EA primary results; record archive/member hashes.
Run the canonical F-host HTTP/DOM acceptance at port 8012 after runner outputs are present.
Mark RESOLVED only after required F-host receipts, fresh claim/heartbeat and accepted runner outputs are remotely verified.
